notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in hand.
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Llanowar Scout's ability by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
If the land is mana-producing and enters the battlefield untapped, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Trench Behemoth's ability by returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Necrotic Ooze.
Repeat.
